verdict.rationale: DBOS runs locally as a library: there is no separate orchestration server, only Postgres is needed, and the app starts with `python3 main.py` after `dbos init`. Optional local Conductor/Console can be run with Docker Compose. For testing, the docs only say workflows are ordinary Python functions you can test with pytest or unittest, so there are no dedicated testing utilities. missing for 10: dedicated workflow test harness, time-skipping for sleeps/timeouts, built-in step mocking, a single command that also provisions Postgres, and independent hands-on corroboration of the local/testing experience.
